items.title: US House votes to derail impeachment of Pete Hegseth – video
items.summary: Republicans in the US House of Representatives banded together on Tuesday, 10 November, to derail an effort to impeach defense secretary Pete Hegseth. The chamber voted 211 to 204 in favor of a motion to refer the impeachment charges to the Republican-led…
